actions.script: if (!entitiesToInclude) entitiesToInclude = null if (entitiesToInclude != null && !Array.isArray(entitiesToInclude)) entitiesToInclude = [entitiesToInclude] if (!entitiesToSkip) entitiesToSkip = null if (entitiesToSkip != null && !Array.isArray(entitiesToSkip)) entitiesToSkip = [entitiesToSkip] if (fileType == "CSV") filePerEntity = true jobRunId = ec.service.job("ExportEntityDataSnapshot") .parameters({fromDate: fromDate, thruDate: thruDate, baseFilename: baseFilename, fileType: fileType, filePerEntity: filePerEntity, isoDateTime: isoDateTime, tableColumnNames: tableColumnNames, entitiesToSkip: entitiesToSkip, entitiesToInclude: entitiesToInclude}).run()
actions.message: Started Export Entity Data Snapshot ${baseFilename} (Job ID ${jobRunId})

default-field.tooltip: Defaults to include all if none selected and one or more skip entities specified
CSV ONLY, use table and column names instead of entity and field names
The foreign keys of the snapshot's tables are dropped, the snapshot imported on a worker, and the keys made again after it, as database jobs (DATABASE_ADMIN)

option.text: Drop foreign keys first and create them after
